name: Hollywood Regency
summary: The decorator's room of the film stars. Regency and neoclassical forms meet lacquer colour, bold stripes and mirror; a symmetric plan around a centre piece, white plaster and gilt make each room ready for a camera.

philosophy.core_thesis: A room is a stage set: bold colour, gloss and symmetry make the people in it look their best.
design_principles: Plan the room around one centre piece, such as a round table or an ottoman, with seats in pairs about it.
Use one saturated colour boldly, often lacquered, against white or black.
Add mirror and gilt for sparkle: mirrored furniture, gilt frames and brass fittings.
Use bold graphic pattern on one surface: wide stripes, trellis or a black and white floor.
Mix Regency and neoclassical forms, such as klismos chairs and pagodas, with modern comfort.
Make the room photogenic: warm light that flatters faces and a clear view of each pair.
anti_patterns: Muted earth palettes with no contrast

composition.plan_logic: A symmetric plan around a centre piece. Pairs of sofas, chairs and lamps face each other across it; a lacquer or mirror wall closes the axis.
composition.focal_point: A round centre table or tufted ottoman under a chandelier in the middle of the room.

rules.rule: Arrange pairs of seats and lamps on two axes that cross at the centre piece.
Put the focal point in the centre of the floor under the chandelier.
Set one lacquered saturated colour against white plaster and black accents.
Repeat one bold stripe or trellis on one surface only.
Balance each piece with its twin across the centre.
Make the centre piece and the chandelier the richest; the walls stay plain.
Give white and the lacquer colour the main shares and gilt and black the accents.
Light the faces with warm lamps in pairs and a crystal chandelier; avoid downlight.
Keep the view from the door to the centre piece open.
rules.value: furniture on the axis below 80 cm

rules.rule: Keep a ring route around the centre group.

zoning.circulation: A ring route around the centre group and two straight routes on the axes.

palette.distribution: White plaster and one lacquered colour (emerald, coral or peacock blue) on walls or furniture; black on a floor or trim; gilt and mirror for the accents.

lighting.strategy: Warm light that flatters faces. Pairs of lamps at face height and a crystal chandelier give sparkle; mirrors double each source.
lighting.daylight: Tall windows with full curtains on gilt poles; daylight reflects from mirror and lacquer.

layers.source: pairs of tall lamps with pleated shades
layers.position: on side tables at each end of the sofas

materials.finish: High-gloss lacquer, mirror and polished brass.
materials.texture_contrast: Gloss and mirror against tufted velvet, at about 2:1 in favour of gloss.

furniture.silhouette: Neoclassical and Regency forms in clean, smooth lines: klismos chairs, tufted sofas, pagoda and faux-bamboo pieces.
furniture.arrangement: Matched pairs face each other across a round centre table or ottoman.

textiles.pattern: One bold graphic pattern: wide stripe, trellis or chinoiserie.
textiles.windows: Full silk or satin curtains with a shaped pelmet, on gilt poles.

objects.approach: Glamorous pieces in pairs: porcelain, gilt, crystal and framed portraits.

implementation.brief: A white plaster room with an emerald lacquered back wall and a black and white floor. Two tufted coral sofas face each other across a round tufted ottoman under a crystal chandelier; pagoda lamps, a mirrored chest and gilt mirrors stand in pairs.
implementation.image_prompt: Hollywood Regency living room, symmetrical, white plaster walls and an emerald green lacquered wall, black and white checkerboard floor, two coral velvet tufted sofas facing each other, round tufted ottoman in the centre, crystal chandelier, pair of pagoda lamps, mirrored chest, gilt sunburst mirrors, glossy and glamorous, 1950s Los Angeles, interior photograph
implementation.negative_prompt: Rustic, matt earth tones, asymmetric, cold light, clutter, raw wood.
implementation.camera: 24 mm lens at 140 cm, frontal view on the cross axis through the centre piece.
implementation.scene_3d: Room 650 x 550 cm, ceiling 300 cm. One 2700 K crystal chandelier at 220 cm; four 2700 K lamps at 130 cm; lacquer roughness 0.05.
furniture_list: 2 sofas 210 x 90 x 80 cm, seat 44 cm

references.credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Harris Brisbane Dick Fund, 1930

emotion.target_response: Delight: the viewer feels glamorous and on show, as on a film set.

avoid_when: The brief asks for calm or natural materials.
The room has no centre, such as a narrow corridor.

modifiers.how: Replace the lacquer colour with black lacquer and veneer, add stepped and fan forms and cove light.
Replace the gloss with fluted wood and bouclé, round all corners and warm the palette.

canonical_works.work: Interiors for film stars in Los Angeles
